scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: South office window spans approximated from the dimension chain 2190/1200/360/660/1200/2190 pattern; small 360/660mm sub-segments merged/simplified rather than modelled as separate small openings.

The thin unfilled vertical line near x=718 in the north hall is interpreted as a non-wall (ceiling/beam) mark, not a partition, because it lacks any gray wall-fill pixels found elsewhere for real partitions.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Exact door widths/positions for the 4 south offices and the hall's double door are visually estimated, not individually dimensioned.
F2 east/west window height family assumed identical to north/south F2 windows pending direct cross-check.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

plan_compilation.basis: 2f_view.png: calibrated from top '15000' dimension ticks (x=427->0m,x=1813->15m) and left '8000' dimension ticks (y=328->8m north,y=1067->0m south). Outer wall faces confirmed at x=427/1813(ish) and y=331/1071 by direct gray-pixel profiling. North half (y=331-600) is ONE open conference hall: the thin non-filled vertical line near x=718 has no gray fill and no wall-thickness pixel support, unlike all real partitions (which are gray-filled or clearly double-line to the exterior), so it is treated as a non-wall (ceiling/beam) mark, not a room divider; the two round tables share one wide double-door opening into the corridor (matches North wall single continuous window band per side, confirmed against the 1950/3600/1889/1891/3600/1950 north dimension chain which places a solid/door zone at the centre, not a second partition). South half (y=800-1071) has 4 offices divided by 3 real partitions located by direct pixel inspection at x=727,1115,1456, each with its own corridor door. Window spans on north/south walls from cumulative dimension chains anchored at x=427. West/East single-window openings (F2) matched to West_view.png/East_view.png upper row (3400/1200/3400 offset pattern) at the corridor's mid-depth.

limits: Two caller-supplied anchors per axis define the transform but do not independently close a dimension chain.
The overlay does not inspect original pixels or automatically decide positional error.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
